item.author: invalid@example.com (Lifejumper)

item.content:encoded: Star Wars Zero Company sold over a million copies. Its studio has just laid off staff Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor has laid off an unspecified number of staff, a month after bringing some furloughed developers back. www.eurogamer.net Several developers announced on LinkedIn on Friday, 6th November, that they had been let go, as first reported by Bespin Bulletin . Bit Reactor hasn't said how many people are affected.
